answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. A tide of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dune of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the walnut of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
